verdict.rationale: The only region-related evidence is a choice between a Global API endpoint (api-singapore) and a China API endpoint (api-beijing) (kling-docs-11). That selects where API requests are sent, not where user data is stored. It is an adjacent feature that earns no credit for a data-residency story. Nothing in the pack documents user-selectable storage region or data-residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
